title: [LAB-06] Validate GPU lifetime fixes and diagnose indirect-execution stalls
problem: Upstream reports black world frames and device loss; issues #11 and #16 also report hangs during menus. A 30 FPS menu counter does not establish stable rendering.
steps: Review upstream reports and extract a minimal synthetic reproduction when possible.
Track descriptor reuse, fence completion, resource barriers and lifetimes across submission.
Collect GPU fault information available under RADV/vkd3d; stop a failing run and preserve its diagnostics.
acceptance: The specific fault has before/after evidence and a focused regression.
A bounded run shows correct rendered output and no device loss.
Do not mask hangs by extending driver timeouts, dropping draws or disabling validation.
body:
Development base: Marvisak/VIctory at 1dd7afd4e68300e5dea41cd33a6e0b297798bb2f.

Upstream commit 8c26061 fixes null-descriptor kinds and resource lifetimes, and reports a bounded world run without device removal. World frames remain black and slow; indirect execution is disabled by default and triggers the title watchdog when enabled. Validate the fixes under vkd3d and isolate the remaining stall.

## Ownership

Unclaimed. Comment to claim this task and name the files/functions you will edit. Submit one focused PR and coordinate shared files before changing them.

## Scope

- crates/victory-gpu/src/host.rs
- crates/victory-gpu/src/descriptor/host.rs
- crates/victory-gpu/src/shadow.rs and queue.rs

## Work

1. Review upstream issues #11/#16 and commit 8c26061. Start from its descriptor/lifetime fixes and extract a synthetic regression for any remaining fault.
2. Track descriptor reuse, fences and resource lifetimes. Separately inspect indirect argument clamping, per-list budgets and the watchdog-triggering submission.
3. Collect GPU fault information available under RADV/vkd3d; stop a failing run and preserve its diagnostics.

## Done when

- [ ] The specific fault has before/after evidence and a focused regression.
- [ ] A bounded run shows correct rendered output and no device loss.
- [ ] Do not mask hangs by extending driver timeouts, dropping draws or disabling validation.
